_note: How each role is looked up in Malaysian job postings on freehire.me. 'query' is a full-text search (it also matches descriptions, so its total is postings that mention the role); 'titles' are the words (whole words, any case) a posting's title must contain to be listed as an opening for the role. Team: review these when a role's list looks off (REVIEW_LOG.md).

production_operator.query: "production operator" OR "operator pengeluaran" OR "assembly operator" OR "operator kilang"

hotel_front_desk_clerk.query: "front desk" OR "hotel receptionist" OR "guest service agent"

farm_worker.query: "plantation worker" OR "pekerja ladang" OR "farm worker" OR "general worker ladang"

engineering_technician.query: "BIM Modeller" OR "BIM Coordinator" OR "Drafter" OR "Pelukis Pelan" OR "CAD Drafter"

accounts_clerk.query: "accounts clerk" OR "payroll clerk" OR "kerani akaun" OR "accounts assistant"

supply_chain_specialist.query: "Supply Chain Specialist" OR "Logistics Specialist" OR "Supply Chain Executive" OR "Logistics Executive"

bank_teller.query: "bank teller" OR "bank cashier" OR "customer service teller" OR "pegawai kaunter bank"

tvet_instructor.query: "TVET instructor" OR "tenaga pengajar TVET" OR "vocational teacher" OR "vocational training officer"
